title: Letters from Assyrian and Babylonian Scholars (SAA 10), incl. substitute-king dossier / Письма ассирийских и вавилонских учёных
author: Court scholars of Esarhaddon and Assurbanipal
size: SAA 10: 389 letters; also SAA 8 astrological reports
edition: Parpola, SAA 10 (1993); Hunger, SAA 8 (1992); online at SAAo/ORACC (licence to verify).
ru_evidence: CyberLeninka ('заместительный царь ассирийские письма', 'ассирийские астрологи письма перевод') finds no translation; none found.
en_evidence: en.wikipedia State Archives of Assyria: SAA 8 (Hunger 1992) and SAA 10 (Parpola 1993) with English translations.
value: An inside view of 'Chaldaean' scholarship, eclipse anxiety and the substitute-king ritual. Illuminates Arrian 7.24 (a pseudo-king on Alexander's throne) and Greek images of the Chaldaeans.
ai_feasibility: high: open transliterations and epistolary formulae. The English edition is used only for cross-checking.
